conclusion: FINAL ANSWER: the 10 candidate lines most likely in the high-GRWT100 (top-quartile) class, in order, are 12254, 12349, 12344, 12242, 10645, 12228, 12129, 12229, 11340, 11094. conclusion: Closed-loop design executed in 3 phenotyping rounds within the 30-query budget: Round 1 re-measured the top-10 (5.0,4.7,4.6,4.5,3.8,3.8,3.7,3.7,3.6,3.6, all reproduced); Round 2 probed E1 ranks 54-65 and discovered a buried 4.1 g line (IRIS_313.10645, E1 rank 55); Round 3 probed E1 ranks 66-73 (one 3.6 g line, IRIS_313.9193).
